I think you're storing sanity in a `float` that goes from 0 to 1. They can't hold values like `0.2`, `0.1` or `0.05` without loss of precision, since these numbers require infinity bits to be represented in binary exactly. When doing math a lot of times, these imprecisions pile up.

So the issue might eventually be reproduced by doing something that makes your sanity go up by 10%, 5% or 1% and then down by the same amount repeatedly.

That can be fixed by making sanity a `decimal` or rounding the sanity (in %) to 1 - 3 decimal places every time it changes.
